# Data

Use the Scottish Metastatic Breast Cancer Data provided in Canvas (`scottish_mbc_cohort.xlsx`). 

The data is also available [here (click link)](https://github.com/Edinburgh-Cancer-Informatics/onco-stats/tree/main/docs/data).

# Instructions

Work thrugh the examples and exercises in the [tutorial on survival analysis](https://edinburgh-cancer-informatics.github.io/onco-stats/tutorials/survival_analysis_tutorial.html) provided by the Edinburgh Cancer Informatics Group.

It relates to chapter 1-3 in Collet.

# Additional recommended resources

- Chapter 29-31 from [Thomas E. Love](https://thomaselove.github.io/432-notes/survival_data.html)
